occurrences.source_assessment: The source explicitly names the acetate-producing Synechocystis WT_PKPa_RBS_BsPta_Δacs strain paired with E.coli BL21-derived Pem7_ButOH. The P.taiwanensis pairing is a separate experimental consortium, E.coli T7 is a subcloning host, and the Pthl construct is a separate tested version; none is an additional member of this canonical pair. The exact genotype remains source-supported but no study-strain genome classification was performed here.
